en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Maymoun, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws used to say: ‘O Allahazwj! I seek Refuge with Youazwj from the wet dreams and the evil dreams, and that the Satanla would play with measws during the wakefulness and the sleep’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from his father from ‘Abd Allah ibn Maymun from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Amir al-Mu’minin, Ali ibn abu Talib (a.s.) would say, ‘O Lord, I seek protection with You against wet dreams and bad dreams and from Satan playing with me during my sleep or when awake.’”
